text_blocks.snippet: Polygenic diseases are conditions caused by the combined effects of multiple genes, often interacting with environmental factors. Unlike diseases caused by a single gene (monogenic), polygenic diseases involve the interplay of several genes, each with a potentially small individual impact, but collectively contributing to the overall risk or manifestation of the disease.
